description: This file defines the PersistableOrderProduct class, which extends OrderProductEntity and implements Serializable. It includes attributes for price and product attributes, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PersistableOrderProduct
classes.description: A class representing an order product with persistence capabilities, including additional attributes such as price and product attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of product attributes for this order product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of product attributes associated with this order product.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Gets the final price of the product.

methods.name: setPrice
methods.description: Sets the final price of the product.
